senses.sense_definition: An extremely wealthy and influential business magnate who exercises considerable political influence.

examples.text: The international community imposed strict sanctions on every <w>oligarch</w> linked to the regime.
A powerful <w>oligarch</w> used his immense wealth to buy media outlets and influence the election.

senses.sense_definition: A member of an oligarchy; one of a small group of people who govern a country or organization.

examples.text: In ancient history, each <w>oligarch</w> fought to protect the privileges of the ruling elite.
The nation was controlled by an <w>oligarch</w> who made decisions behind closed doors.

senses.sense_definition: A protoplanet formed by the process of oligarchic accretion during the early evolution of a planetary system.

examples.text: During the final phase of planet formation, each celestial <w>oligarch</w> swept up surrounding debris.
The inner solar system once contained a giant <w>oligarch</w> that collided with other bodies.
